title: 20XX [XCI+BIN][RUS/Multi]
description:
20XX is a roguelike action platformer that you can play with a friend. Jump and shoot your way through ever-changing levels, collect awesome new powers, and battle mighty bosses in the name of saving the human race maybe!

20XX also features full co-op. Play with a friend on the couch or over the internet!

20XX supports 1-2 players locally or online.

Features:
• Crisp, precise controls - do exactly what you want your character to!
• Over 100 mighty powerups to collect!
• Tons of different play modes and optional difficulty modifiers!
• Seeded Daily and Weekly Challenges!
• All gameplay features available in both single player and co-op! (online or local)

Roguelike Elements:
• Random levels: each time you play 20XX, the stages you play through will be brand new!
• Permanent death: each 20XX playthrough is a self-contained life! Death sends you back to HQ, where you can buy powerful upgrades for future runs. (There's also a Reverent Mode where you get three lives to make it through the game instead of one.)
• Persistent Upgrades: as you play 20XX, you'll earn Soul Chips, which unlock powerful Permanent Upgrades and expand the pool of items that can you can find as you play!

title: Infinity Blade (port ) [NRO][ENG]
publisher: aks796, InfinityBladeGuy, Rinnegatamante, Andy Nguyen, fgsfds
description:
The first iOS video game to be powered by Unreal Engine 3, Infinity Blade puts you through a series of one-on-one battles by swiping to attack and parry, as well as dodging and blocking attacks. The game became the highest-grossing application in Apple history at that time - 271,424 copies were sold in 4 days, and since its release it has received 4 major updates and great approval from game critics.
In the citadel lives a certain God-King, who in an unusual way remains immortal, but there is an Infinity Blade, which he also owns, only this weapon can destroy him. The hero wants to overthrow the Tsar for the sake of peace and prosperity, but is defeated. The God Tsar says that the hero has a strong pedigree, and it will serve him well: 20 years pass - now his son is again standing in front of the castle, wanting to avenge his father and overthrow the God Tsar...

title: Sigma Star Saga DX [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The classic shooter/RPG is back and better than ever! Featuring a unique mix of side-scrolling shoot-'em-up space battles and top-down planetary exploration, Sigma Star Saga DX is an explosive genre mashup that lets you take control of Allied Earth Federation pilot Ian Recker and infiltrate the alien Krill Empire as a double agent in a last-ditch effort to save mankind. 

With loyalties divided between humans and Krill, you must investigate six planets using an ever-expanding set of tools and abilities, and jump into the cockpit to engage enemy forces in intense shmup-style combat using more than 70 different Gun Data items. Gorgeous pixel-art graphics, epic boss battles, and a twist-filled story with multiple endings await. 

The new DX version adds numerous refinements over the original 2005 release, including an improved map, decreased random encounter rate, rebalanced EXP system, enhanced dialogue, additional save points, assorted bug fixes and quality-of-life updates, and more.

Key Features:
• The handheld classic returns after 20 years!
• Top-down RPG-style exploration mixed with action-packed space-shooter battles!
• Survive as a double agent for the humans and the Krill, and discover the secret of the six planets
• Stunning pixel-art graphics and fantastic soundtrack
• Explore using tools like the Scanner, Krill Boots, Wings, and more
• Customize your ship with more than 70 different Gun Data items yielding 15,000+ combinations
• Branching story with multiple endings
• The definitive DX version adds an improved map, decreased random encounter rate, rebalanced EXP system, updated script, various bug fixes, and other enhancements

title: Leafy Corner [NSP][RUS/Multi13]
description:
Run the plant shop of your dreams in Leafy Corner, a cozy shop management game where you grow, sell, and care for real-life houseplants!

Step into the role of a plant shop owner. Grow plants, serve your customers, and create a warm, inviting space filled with greenery and charm.

Watch your plants grow over time, unfolding leaf by leaf as you care for them.

Not everyone knows what they’re looking for. Sometimes customers bring unusual or tricky requests. Finding just the right plant to fit their needs adds a fun challenge.

Decorate your shop with a variety of unlockable items, from shelves to plant pots. Pick colors that fit your mood and create a space that reflects your unique style.

KEY FEATURES
- Grow, care for, and sell 100+ unique plants.
- Discover plant variegations.
- Build and decorate your shop with a variety of pots, furniture, and decoration options.
- Fulfill orders and help customers.
- Complete tasks to progress your shop.
- Increase your shop’s reputation to unlock new content.
- Customize your character.

What Leafy Corner does NOT offer:
- Hardcore management (deep economy, hiring staff).
- Advanced plant care.
- Storyline.

title: Absurdika Rebuild [NSP][RUS/Multi4]
description:
It was a normal summer day and you were returning home after work. Suddenly, a bright flash in the sky blinded you... And then something appeared with a chainsaw in its hands.
Do you play as an ordinary guy who is trying to break free from his imposed fears and phobias from someone else's world - or in his head? Where is reality, and where is fiction, and sick fantasy? It's up to you to figure this out.
Fight your nightmares, go through many levels, fight different enemies and defeat powerful bosses!..
From a Russian developer.

title: Game and Watch, Elektronika IM — 84 igry (emulator Yokoi, Sharp SM510) [NRO][ENG]
description:
Game & Watch (russ. igra i chasy) — seriya portativnykh elektronnykh igr s ZhK-ekranom. Seriya byla sozdana razrabotchikom igr Gumpeem Yokoem v kompanii Nintendo, igry vypuskalis s 1980 goda. Bolshinstvo ustroystv pozvolyalo igrat tolko v odnu igru — eto ogranichenie bylo vyzvano ispolzovaniem segmentirovannogo ZhK-ekrana. Na mnogikh igrakh nakhodilis knopki «Igra A» i «Igra B», prichyom igra B obychno byla prosto bolee bystroy i slozhnoy versiey igry A.
«Elektronika» — seriya sovetskikh elektronnykh igr, v osnovnom obedinyonnykh v edinuyu seriyu «IM» — igra mikroprotsessornaya. Chast igr etogo semeystva yavlyalis kopiyami, analogami i variatsiyami Game & Watch serii «Wide Screen», vypushchennykh kompaniey Nintendo v 1981—1982 godakh (EGG, Octopus, Mickey Mouse, Chef i drugie); vypuskalis s serediny vosmidesyatykh zavodami «Angstrem», «Mikron» (Zelenograd), «Arzamasskim zavodom radiodetaley» (Arzamas), «Billyur» (Gyandzha), «Evistor» (Vitebsk), «Kamerton» (Pinsk), «Oktyabr» (Vinnitsa), «Proton» (Oryol), «Severodonetskim priborostroitelnym zavodom» (Severodonetsk), «Voskhod» (Kaluga), «Ellar» (Riga), i nekotorymi drugimi.
«Yokai» — eto standalone-emulyator (ne simulyator) igr G&W i «Elektroniki», sozdannykh na mikroprotsessore Sharp SM5A, SM510, SM511 i SM512.

title: Vita3K-nx: emulator PlayStation Vita (PSV) + game Gravity Rush / Daze [NRO][RUS]
interface_lang: Russian [RUS], port ofitsialnogo perevoda iz PS4-version s vychitkoy ot cobra838
description:
PlayStation Vita, PS Vita (yap. プレイステーション・ヴィータ Pureysute:syon Vi:ta) — portativnaya konsol ot Sony Computer Entertainment, preemnik PlayStation Portable. Vypushchena v Yaponii 17 dekabrya 2011 goda, v Severnoy Amerike i Evrope — 22 fevralya 2012 goda, nazyvalas PSP2, o kotoroy, kak i o PlayStation Phone bylo izvestno po slukham ot storonnikh razrabotchikov. Do E3 2011 sistema byla izvestna pod rabochim nazvaniem Next Generation Portable, NGP.
Vita3K — glavnyy polnotsennyy eksperimentalnyy emulyator portativnoy konsoli PlayStation Vita s otkrytym iskhodnym kodom, rasprostranyaemyy po litsenzii MIT. Imeet priyatnyy minimalistichnyy dizayn, pozvolyaet zapuskat bolshuyu chast kommercheskikh igry i polzovatelskikh khoumbryu-prilozheniy, sozdannykh dlya PS Vita. Sovmestimost postoyanno rastet, a spisok podderzhivaemykh proektov regulyarno obnovlyaetsya.
«Gravity Rush» — iznachalno eksklyuziv PS Vita, reliz sostoyalsya 13 iyunya 2012 goda. Syuzhet rasskazyvaet istoriyu devushki Ket, kotoraya poteryala pamyat i teper pytaetsya uznat, kto ona, a takzhe spasti svoyo budushchee v razvalivayushchemsya mire. Ket obladaet interesnoy sposobnostyu – ona mozhet izmenyat gravitatsiyu, no ne na vsey planete, a lish v nebolshoy zone vokrug sebya. Ispolzuya takuyu sposobnost, devushka mozhet peremeshchatsya dazhe po stenam zdaniy; igra prisutstvuet v etoy razdache.Videotreyler.

title: Slay the Spire 2 (port ) [NRO][RUS/Multi14]
publisher: ChanseyIsTheBest, Ekyso, Rinnegatamante, Andy Nguyen, fgsfds
description:
«Vse mysli u nas byli tolko o Shpile…»
Kultovyy kartochnyy rogalik vozvrashchaetsya! Soberite svoyu kolodu, povstrechayte prichudlivykh monstrov i otyshchite mnozhestvo mogushchestvennykh relikviy v Slay the Spire 2!
Tysyachu let Shpil prebyval v zabvenii, ego tayny byli pogrebeny, a uzhasy zabyty. No vot on vnov raspakhnul vrata, polnyy nevidannykh ranee opasnostey i gotovyy zhadno poglotit kazhdogo, kto osmelitsya stupit na tropu k ego vershine. Chtoby protivostoyat novym ugrozam, vam potrebuetsya ottochennaya strategiya, gibkoe myshlenie i nepokolebimaya vyderzhka. Preodoleyte kovarnye ispytaniya Shpilya i raskroyte ego tayny. Poprobuete vzoyti na vershinu v odinochku?

title: Tome of the Damned [NSZ][RUS/Multi15]
description:
Become the Nightmare of All Humanity

Tome of the Damned is a dark and gripping top-down roguelike that tells the tragic story of a mage whose reckless experiments with forbidden magic ended in disaster. Once a powerful sorcerer, you are now a living corpse doomed to endless cycles of reincarnation, inhabiting the bodies of the dead. Your lair lies deep within the castle’s dungeons, surrounded by former allies and castle guards who are determined to keep you locked away to prevent your dark magic from escaping.

Your journey begins in the deepest, darkest corners of the castle. Step by step, you fight your way toward freedom, facing increasingly powerful foes-seasoned warriors, cunning mages, and relentless guards willing to give their lives to stop you.

Along the way, you discover ancient altars that serve as sources of power.

These altars allow you to enhance your weapons, unlock powerful spells, and improve your attributes, offering countless paths to develop your abilities and adapt to the trials ahead.

Choose one of five enchanted weapons and one of four magical grimoires, then grind your enemies to dust. But don’t worry if you happen to die.

After all, you still have plenty of bodies left-you can simply take a new one.

title: Karma City Police [NSP][ENG]
description:
Karma City Police is a narrative-driven police dispatch simulator with pinball-based combat and adventure elements.

Serve the role of the new dispatcher at the Karma City Police Station. Speak to distressed callers to discover their emergency, and then allocate resources needed to save the day.

Explore a dense and vivid police station, battle enemies in a unique pinball mini-game, and enjoy a captivating story with lots of humor and eccentric characters.


Features
* Police dispatch simulator
* Top-down exploration
* Unique pinball battles
* Nostalgic pixel art and original music

title: Kejora [NSZ][ENG]
description:
There’s a mystery hidden behind this peaceful village, unknown to its inhabitants, who carry on with their daily lives.

Kejora features hand-drawn art and animation, environmental platformer puzzles, and party-based inspired gameplay with 2 supporting characters with unique skills to help Kejora in her exploration and journey.

Key Features:

◆Beautiful visuals: Immerse yourself in the story, accompanied by stunning, hand-drawn landscapes, characters, and animation.
    
◆Party-based inspired gameplay: Kejora is accompanied by her two friends on her journey, each with their own unique abilities to help Kejora overcome obstacles and puzzles.
  
◆Puzzle platformer adventure: Explore various hand-drawn environments, and with the help of Kejora and her friends, discover items that can help you, solve puzzles, and defeat enemies.

title: Captain Tsubasa 2: World Fighters + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The next episode of Tsubasa’s riveting adventure is here! Enjoy the thrill of spectacular soccer actions with 110 playable characters and new sensational super moves. Challenge a friend in the field or support Tsubasa on his Journey, the ball is yours.

• New and Improved Gameplay
Action on the field has been enhanced with powerful new super moves that intensify every action, from passing to blocking. The updated system adds more strategy, especially in goalkeeper versus shooter duels featuring spectacular super shots and blocks from the original series characters.

• A Soccer World That is Bigger Than Before!
Featuring 22 national teams, over 110 playable characters, and more than 150 cutscenes highlighting moves on the pitch! Previously unseen teams from the manga and original teams and characters clash in glorious, meticulous animation. The excitement of these once-in-a-lifetime moments has never been higher!

• Experience the New Storylines based on the World Youth Arc supervised by Yoichi Takahashi
Pick up where the first game left off and follow Tsubasa as he takes on formidable new rivals in the thrilling story based on the World Youth arc.
Discover expanded storylines overseen by the original creator, Yoichi Takahashi, and witness powerhouse nations clash as they chase international glory.
Step onto the pitch in the NEW STARS ROUTE, create your own custom player, join the Japanese national team, and fight alongside Tsubasa on the road to world victory.

• Powerful and Inspiring Music
Tadayoshi Makino (SpinSolfa), praised for his moving BGM tracks from the previous title, brings over 100 energized tracks to this iteration. Dare to compete with this exhilarating compilation of melodies perfectly suited to the high-octane action of Captain Tsubasa, the king of sports of anime, as Tsubasa and his teammates give their all on the pitch for the ultimate victory.

*This product is the Standard Edition. Other editions with additional content are available, so be careful of duplicate purchases.

title: Ila a Frosty Glide [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
description:
A COZY EXPLORATION PLATFORMER ADVENTURE
Ila’s beloved kitty, Coco, has mysteriously disappeared, and she’s determined to bring him back home! Explore a whimsical small open world as Ila, a spirited young witch-in-training flying on a magic Skatebroom. Uncover hidden stories, collect valuable items, and improve your magical flying abilities.

GLIDE AROUND
Have you ever dreamed of flying on a skateboard? Feel the wind as you glide effortlessly through the crisp mountain air on Ila’s magical skatebroom as you explore the enchanting island. The core mechanic focuses on the pure joy of movement. Master and upgrade your flying skills, soar to new heights and tackle thrilling platforming challenges along the way.

DISCOVER THE STORY OF ILA AND THE ISLAND
Dive into the rich lore of the island as you uncover ancient secrets and forgotten stories. Piece together the history of the land and its connection to Ila’s past, revealing surprising ties between her dreams and the mysteries of this enchanted place.

FIND SECRET PLACES AND RELAX
Explore Ila’s magical island at your own pace and relax. Find hidden nooks and uncovered treasures flying on your skatebroom. But also indulge yourself pausing and enjoying the view from high vantage points. Savor the serene beauty and tranquil freedom of the snow-covered landscape on your magical skatebroom.

WITCHY CUSTOMIZATION
Express your creativity by personalizing Ila’s appearance! Find special items around the island or collect coins to use at the magic shop. Choose from a variety of outfits, hats, capes and skatebrooms to create a unique look that reflects your own style.

ENJOY THE IMMERSIVE SOUNDTRACK
Feel the magic of Ila’s world and enjoy the captivating original soundtrack. Each track evolves with Ila’s adventure inviting you to relax and grows alongside your journey to guide you toward Coco’s clues with every note.

title: Astonishia Story (어스토니시아 스토리) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Sto let nazad Drevo Zhizni pogiblo, a elfiyskiy narod nachal umirat. Brimkhil, vsegda molodaya i prekrasnaya Koroleva elfov pozhertvovala svoey vechnoy molodostyu, chtoby vozrodit Drevo. Sto let spustya, uzhe v nashi dni i poluelf Frensis De La Kross pytaetsya poluchit silu bogopodobnogo sushchestva, chtoby perelomit situatsiyu v protivostoyanii protiv lyudey i dat Brimkhil molodost snova — pered eyo smertyu.
V eto vremya, molodoy rytsar po imeni ser Lloyd fon Royental perevozit svyashchennyy posokh, izvestnyy kak Zhezl Kinana. Na nego sovershaetsya zhestokoe pokushenie, posokh kradet Frensis, posle chego Lloyd otpravlyaetsya na ego poiski.. Po puti k nemu prisoedinyayutsya neskolko drugikh pomoshchnikov, kotorye poydut vmeste s nim (i vami) po sovershenno raznym prichinam.
Samaya pervaya igra serii byla vypushchena v Yuzhnoy Koree v 1994 godu dlya PK pod upravleniem MS-DOS. Sikvel byl vypushchen v iyule 1994 goda dlya Windows pod nazvaniem Astonishia Story: Forgotten Saga. V 2002 godu remeyk originalnoy igry, Astonishia Story R, byl vypushchen dlya koreyskoy portativnoy sistemy GP32, kotoryy vposledstvii byl portirovan na PlayStation Portable.

title: Grand Theft Auto V (port GTA 5) [NRO][RUS/Multi12]
description:
Kogda otstavnoy grabitel bankov, molodoy ulichnyy zhulik i opasnyy dlya obshchestva psikhopat vtroyom okazyvayutsya vtyanuty v razborki s samymi pugayushchimi i sumasshedshimi predstavitelyami kriminalnogo mira, pravitelstva SShA i industrii razvlecheniy, im prikhoditsya vypolnit seriyu riskovannykh naletov, chtoby vyzhit v bezzhalostnom gorode, gde oni ne mogut doveryat nikomu – i v pervuyu ochered drug drugu…
Deystvie igry proiskhodit v vymyshlennom shtate San-Andreas, proobrazom kotorogo posluzhila Yuzhnaya Kaliforniya. Syuzhet v odnopolzovatelskom rezhime stroitsya vokrug priklyucheniy troikh grabiteley, ustraivayushchikh vsyo bolee derzkie ogrableniya i protivostoyashchikh kak organizovannoy prestupnosti, tak i pravookhranitelnym vedomstvam. V protsesse igry igrok upravlyaet vybrannym personazhem v rezhime ot pervogo ili ot tretego litsa; personazh mozhet svobodno peredvigatsya po obshirnomu miru igry kak peshkom, tak i na avtomobilyakh i drugikh vidakh transporta. Osobennostyu Grand Theft Auto V po sravneniyu s drugimi igrami serii yavlyaetsya vozmozhnost pereklyuchatsya mezhdu personazhami v lyuboy moment, kak vo vremya vypolneniya zadaniy, tak i vne ikh. Mnogie zadaniya igry svyazany s ogrableniyami i ugonom avtomobiley; pri etom igrovoy personazh mozhet uchastvovat v perestrelkakh i pogonyakh.
Bolshoe vnimanie so storony razrabotchikov poluchili missii i zanyatiya. Dlya kazhdogo iz 3-kh glavnykh geroev imeyutsya svoi missii, vypolnyat ikh mozhno prakticheski vsegda v lyubom poryadke, pereklyuchayas mezhdu protagonistami. V predydushchikh igrakh serii bylo mnozhestvo odnotipnykh zadaniy, v GTA V zhe prakticheski vse syuzhetnye missii osobenny: ot zakhvatyvayushchey pogoni za sobstvennoy yakhtoy do samogo masshtabnogo ogrableniya federalnogo rezerva. A eshchyo kazhdyy personazh imeet svoyo khobbi!

title: Wax Heads [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Wax Heads is a cozy-punk narrative sim about working in a struggling record store. Chat to quirky customers with unique tastes, explore a handcrafted record collection, fall in love with bands (and their drama!), or just slack off with your colleagues - whatever gets everyone’s groove back! 

IMMERSIVE COZY-PUNK LIFE SIM
Lose yourself in an emotional, uplifting narrative about community, musical mysteries and underdog spirit. Help endearing and indecisive customers find their perfect records while debating all things music with your loveable colleagues. It's your job to help Repeater Records find its rhythm again! 

ORIGINAL KILLER SOUNDTRACK
Drop the needle on a stacked soundtrack featuring dozens of original tracks spanning across many genres, bands, and eras. Every song is crafted to feel like a nostalgic gem. From grimy basement bangers to dreamy indie deep cuts. It’s a playlist built to loop in your head long after you clock out. 

HANDCRAFTED RECORD COLLECTION
Dig through crates packed with 80+ hand‑drawn albums, lovingly imagined bands, and liner note lore that rewards curiosity. Each record has its own personality, history, and fanbase. Did Scandinavian metal band Jarhead really murder their singer and put his head in a jar? Is it true big shot rapper RXXX used to be a kid's TV presenter? Has anyone ever seen Mimi? 

MOTLEY CREW OF LOVEABLE ODDBALLS
Repeater Records is staffed and frequented by a rotating cast of eccentrics, music nerds, and chaotic regulars. Every character is bursting with personality, quirks, and questionable opinions about what “real music” is. Get to know them and enjoy their banter. They’re the soul of the shop after all! 

CRATES OF PUZZLES TO DIG THROUGH
From customer requests to store shenanigans, you’ll dive into a variety of cozy puzzles. Decode clues and hunt for the perfect music recommendation by browsing records, scrolling social media, and poring over local music zines. You might even find yourself running the lights for local bands, designing gig posters and packing orders! 

CREATORS OF WAX HEADS
Patattie Games is the two-person indie punk duo made up of developers; creative doodler Murray Somerwolff (Welcome to Elk, Spitkiss, Dead Pets Unleashed) and creative programmer Rothio Tome (Former UNITY developer support engineer and top Spanish GameDev streamer).

title: Planet Quiz Learn and Discover + 4 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Planet Quiz is a charming way to expand your knowledge about Earth, animals, culture… and a guaranteed fun time for you and your friends.

In this game you will find:
» 4 modes - Campaign, Quick Play, Tournament, and Quizpedia.
» Single or Multiplayer options (up to 4 players).
» Three levels of difficulty (easy, medium and hard).
» Various subjects covered in 17 categories, eg. cities, countries, mountains, bodies of water, people, animals, architecture, food, nature wonders. 
» Beautiful, handcrafted visuals.
» Quizpedia with all the information appearing in the game.

title: Metal Gear Solid: Master Collection Edition, Vol. 2 (MGS 4 / Peace Walker / Guns of the Patriots / Metal Gear Ghost Babel) [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Konami Computer Entertainment Japan, Kojima Productions
description:
Metal Gear Solid — seriya videoigr v zhanre stels-ekshen. Prodyuser, rezhissyor, geymdizayner i stsenarist igry, sozdatel serii — Khideo Kodzima.
Kollektsiya vklyuchaet v sebya Metal Gear Solid 4: Guns of the Patriots i Metal Gear Solid: Peace Walker (HD Collection version), a takzhe bonusnyy kontent – tsifrovoy saundtrek i Metal Gear: Ghost Babel.
Predelnoe napryazhenie nezametnogo proniknoveniya na vrazheskuyu territoriyu.. Seriya Metal Gear yavlyaetsya etalonom zhanra «stels-ekshen». Pogruzites v mir Metal Gear – serii, stavshey etalonom zhanra «stealth action», v kotoroy vy pronikaete v tyl protivnika i vypolnyaete razlichnye missii, starayas pri etom izbezhat vstrechi s vragami. Kazhdaya iz igr soderzhit Screenplay Book so vsemi vnutriigrovymi tekstami, a takzhe Master Book s podrobnoy informatsiey o syuzhete i personazhakh. V kachestve bonusov za pokupku kollektsionnogo izdaniya igroki poluchat METAL GEAR Ghost Babel – pervuyu igru serii dlya portativnykh konsoley, vypushchennuyu v 2000 godu, – i Metal Gear Solid: Digital Soundtrack Vol.2 s mnozhestvom legendarnykh trekov ot fonovykh vnutriigrovykh kompozitsiy do polnotsennykh pesen s vokalom, dobavlyayushchikh atmosfernosti missiyam Snake.

title: The Artifactory [NSP][RUS/Multi10]
description:
Welcome to The Artifactory, a fast-paced couch co-op party game where teamwork, creativity, and a little factory chaos keep the production line moving.

Work together with up to four players to gather materials, craft items, and assemble loot boxes before the delivery trucks leave. Pass ingredients along conveyor belts, organize the production line, and keep the factory running smoothly.

But crafting isn’t just about following recipes. Experiment with different raw materials to discover new item combinations and unlock new ways to produce goods. The more you explore, the more efficient your factory can become.

Each level introduces new challenges — moving platforms, tricky conveyor layouts, and unpredictable obstacles that will test your coordination and communication.

Whether you are playing with friends, family, or going solo, every shift at the factory turns into a hilarious cooperative challenge where timing, teamwork, and quick thinking make all the difference.

Can your team master the machines and keep the deliveries on schedule?

Key Features
Local couch co-op for up to 4 players
Experiment with materials to discover new crafting recipes
Build and manage chaotic production lines
Creative factory environments with unique mechanics
Fast, cooperative party gameplay
Perfect for family game nights and multiplayer sessions

title: Simogo Legacy Collection - Nintendo Switch™ 2 Edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
From cute arcade novelties to innovative text-based thrillers and acclaimed fourth wall-breaking stories, Simogo Legacy Collection is an eclectic celebration of Simogo's past, featuring faithful renditions of seven games released on mobile platforms between 2010 and 2015.

• Kosmo Spin
• Bumpy Road
• Beat Sneak Bandit
• Year Walk (+ Year Walk Companion)
• DEVICE 6
• The Sailor’s Dream
• SPL-T

Additionally, Simogo Legacy Collection features bonus content with thoughtfully curated curios from Simogo's wide-ranging history.

• Year Walk Bedtime Stories for Awful Children – E-book
• The Lighthouse Painting – Audio drama Podcast
• Music – Tracks from Simogo’s history, including previously unreleased tracks
• Images – Illustrations from Simogo’s archive
• Year Walk Prototype – Playable prototype
• Bumpy Road Prototype – Playable prototype
• Rollovski Prototype – Playable prototype
• The Sensational December Machine – Playable short story

Requires understanding of written and spoken English to be fully enjoyed.

title: Everwarder (Ever Warder) [NSZ][ENG]
description:
In Everwarder there's you, and a procedurally-generated world covered in darkness. Touch it - and it will spawn a creature that will try to destroy your most precious thing – a crystal with your friend trapped inside. 

TOWER DEFENSE LIKE NO OTHER 
Every run starts with your crystal and a supply of energy. Then it's up to you how to fight the darkness. Do you steadily expand, clearing the darkness, harvesting its energy, and carefully deploying defenders to deal with whatever emerges from the dark? Or do you play it fast and loose, striking out to locate ancient structures and powerful artifacts hidden within? 

EVOLVE AND ADAPT 
Failure is just another word for learning. With every run you gather minerals and unlock new options on the upgrade tree, allowing you to become stronger and last longer against the darkness. After all, time is not on your side: Enemies grow stronger as the seconds tick on - but so do you, gathering new resources, boosts, and upgrading your defenders to last just a bit longer. 

ENDLESS CHALLENGE 
Every run is randomly generated, with its own set of challenges and twists that will keep you on your toes. Every upgrade tweaks the experience, creating various synergies. So even if you struggle to keep up with the pressure, there’s always a way to turn the tides of the battle!

title: Darkest Dungeon: Ancestral edition + 5 DLC: The Fire's Edge, The Color of Madness, The Crimson Court, The Musketeer, The Shieldbreaker [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
description:
Darkest Dungeon is a challenging gothic roguelike turn-based RPG about the psychological stresses of adventuring.

Recruit, train, and lead a team of flawed heroes through twisted forests, forgotten warrens, ruined crypts, and beyond. You'll battle not only unimaginable foes, but stress, famine, disease, and the ever-encroaching dark. Uncover strange mysteries, and pit the heroes against an array of fearsome monsters with an innovative strategic turn-based combat system.

Features: 
•The Affliction System – battle not only monsters, but stress! Contend with paranoia, masochism, fear, irrationality, and a host of gameplay-meaningful quirks!
•Striking hand-drawn gothic crowquill art style
•Innovative turn-based combat pits you against a host of diabolical monsters
•Narration system to celebrate your successes...and failures
•16 (and counting!) playable hero classes, including Plague Doctor, Hellion, and even the Leper!
•Camp to heal wounds or deliver inspiring speeches.
•Rest your weary, shell-shocked characters in town at the Tavern or the Abbey to keep their stress in check.
•Classic CRPG and roguelike features, including character permadeath, procedural dungeons, and incredible replay

Can you stem the tide of eldritch horrors erupting across your family’s ancestral estate?

title: Rabbit Raid [NSP][ENG]
developer: Anastasiya 'SunPixel' Mozilova, Igor 'Mahhaon' Mozilov (Uncle Frost Team)
description:
Collect berries, find secrets with bonuses, throw objects at enemies or jump on them to win. Find secret stars and change costumes. Defeat the bosses and get to the last one to save the little rabbits from captivity. Explore green fields, caves, rivers, snowy mountains, icy lakes, deserts and ruins.

Features:
- 12 different levels
- 8 kinds of enemies
- 10 costumes (not counting the standard)
- Tons of secrets
- Running, jumping, swimming, skating

title: Hillbilly Doomsday (Apocalypse) [NSP][ENG]
developer: Anastasiya 'SunPixel' Mozilova, Igor 'Mahhaon' Mozilov (Uncle Frost Team)
description:
Once upon a time when entire planet was in great danger, an unknown enemy turned almost everyone into zombies. Chaos ensued. The rest of the people are trying to survive. It seems that everything has come to an end…

But among the frightened people there is a hero who ready to save humanity and eradicate the cause of disasters. A hero from small village called Rottenwill - Uncle Billy. He will pass through swamps, caves, dead lands, deep pits and tall buildings until he finds the source of disaster. And then he will eliminate it. You play the role of this brave man and go on a difficult journey to save humanity.

Features:
- Tons of different enemies
- Challenging boss battles
- Optimal choice of weapons for every taste
- Many secret places with useful loot
- Amazing soundtrack

title: Steins Gate Re Boot (Reboot) [RePack][NSP][RUS (Mod.)/ENG]
description:
Proekt predstavlyaet soboy masshtabnoe pereosmyslenie kultovoy istorii o puteshestviyakh vo vremeni. Originalnyy dizayner personazhey huke polnostyu obnovil vneshnost geroev i ikh naryady pod sovremennye standarty, a blagodarya integratsii animatsionnogo dvizhka E-mote privychnye 2D-sprayty poluchili plavnye dvizheniya i zhivuyu mimiku. Kolichestvo fonovykh lokatsiy vyroslo primerno na 20%, a chislo syuzhetnykh illyustratsiy uvelichilos v 2 raza po sravneniyu s originalom. Ves akterskiy sostav zanovo zapisal repliki personazhey, a kompozitor Takesi Abo podgotovil obnovlennye aranzhirovki dlya kazhdogo muzykalnogo treka.
Syuzhetnaya osnova remeyka opiraetsya na stsenariy STEINS;GATE ELITE — dobavili novye dialogi i polnotsennuyu vetku dlya Moeki Kiryu, sozdannuyu na osnove Hyde of the Dark Dimension!Angloyazychnaya versiya tut.
Drugie igry serii STEINS;GATE.

title: Guns of Mercy Rangers edition [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The aliens have invaded the Earth's subsoil!
All Rangers are called to battle to help restore peace. Choose your hero, your weapon and your favorite mecha to clean up the mess

Guns of Mercy is a pixel art shoot and arcade game in which you have to go through hundreds of levels.

Get rid of the 8 bosses in the game. Unlock and upgrade new heroes, weapons or mechas to increase your destructive power.

Play solo or invite up to 3 friends to take part in the fight! Who will be the best?

title: Bunker 22 [NSZ][RUS/ENG]
description:
You wake up in a rotting forest house, your lab coat stained with blood. The world is dead. The people you knew are now things—shambling horrors from a botched experiment. To stop the epidemic, you must descend into the underground lab where it began. But the cure won’t wait, and neither will the monsters hunting you.

Arm yourself to the teeth, because the most vicious monsters will stand in your way. Solve puzzles, look for items, manage resources, do everything possible to save the world from a terrible epidemic, because you are the chosen one.

Breathtaking adventures, an intriguing storyline, and dangerous traps await you. Are you ready to face your fears? Then nothing can stop you.

Game Features:

- Brutal Arsenal: Handguns for precision, shotguns for close-quarters carnage, and traps to surprise your enemies.
- True Survival: Limited ammo, degrading weapons, and monsters that learn your tactics.
- Changing environment: Zombies are stalking you. Hear them scratch at doors, mimic voices, and hide around corners.
- No Handholding: Solve environmental puzzles or survive. The lab’s secrets won’t reveal themselves.

In this game we have mixed the most popular game genres: story adventure, action shooter and survival horror. This is a real gift for all gamers who really like to tickle their nerves.

title: TR-49 [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A voice is saying your name. A WWII-era machine, long hidden in a church basement, whirs to life. Through a crackling speaker, a man asks you to find a stolen book. He only knows the title. Time is running out.

The machine, created by Bletchley Park engineers Cecil Caulderly and Beatrice Dooler, contains a vast archive of obscure books, letters, and journals fed in over the span of fifty years in an attempt to crack the code of reality. As their lives fell apart, the machine kept working.

Navigate the computer’s archive. Link its obscure texts and uncover its creators’ secrets. Communicate with the man behind the speaker to figure out your role in this mystery. Destroy the book at the core of the machine — before it’s too late.

NARRATIVE DEDUCTION

• Deduce links through the archive to locate hidden sources.

• Unravel the stories and unearth the secrets of the books’ authors and the machine's creators.

• Map the archive and find the book that will rewrite the world.

INTERACTIVE AUDIO DRAMA

• Talk with your handler at any time, creating a dynamic audio drama that responds as you explore.

• Featuring the voices of Rebekah McLoughlin, Paul Warren and Phillipe Bosher.

• Original soundtrack by Laurence Chapman.

Written and created by the award-winning team behind Heaven's Vault, Overboard!, and A Highland Song.

title: Sonic Runners Adventure (homebrew) [NRO][RUS/Multi12]
description:
Sonic Runners Adventure is a fun runner with endless platformer elements; its gameplay is reminiscent of its predecessor, Sonic Runners. The first information about the game became known in April and was released on June 10, 2017.
Players choose from several different characters, each of which has a special ability. abilities. There are many golden rings in the levels that need to be collected, otherwise the player will lose if they touch an enemy. If the player has at least one ring, it will scatter to the sides, and it can be collected in a limited time.
According to aggregator website Metacritic, the game received "mostly positive reviews." TouchArcade's Sean Musgrave writes in his review: "Sonic Runners Adventure is easily recommended to Sonic fans who like runners." More Sonic games.

title: Avatar Legends the Fighting Game [RePack][NSZ][RUS (Mod.)]
description:
Featuring hand-drawn 2D animation faithful to the series’ roots, Avatar Legends: The Fighting Game lets you experience the world of Avatar like never before. Choose from 12 playable characters and go head-to-head across a variety of modes, including Offline & Online Versus, Story, Arcade, Training, Spectator, and an Art Gallery.

Standard Edition: 
 
•  Hand-Drawn 2D Animation
Hand-drawn 2D animation faithfully brings characters and their unique fighting styles from Avatar: The Last Airbender, The Legend of Korra, and the expanded universe to life.

• A Wealth of Game Modes
Includes Story Mode, Arcade Mode, Offline & Online Play, Training Mode, Spectator Mode, an Art Gallery featuring never-before-seen concept art.

•  Story and Arcade Mode
Experience an all-new original story outlined by show creators Michael Dante DiMartino and Tim Hedrick. Shape the fate of time and space in the main story mode, then dive into arcade runs featuring storylines for every playable character.

• Robust Training Mode
A Training Mode equips players of all skill levels with advanced tools, including hitboxes, frame data, save states, and more.

• Art Gallery
Explore never-before-seen original artwork from the show, honoring the history, characters, and world of Avatar.

• Easy to Pick Up, Impossible to Put Down
Anyone can start bending with simple, intuitive controls, perfect for quick matches with friends and family. Beneath the surface lies a deep fighting system rewarding technical prowess and creativity.

• Seamless Online Play
Battle players worldwide with rollback netcode and crossplay across multiple platforms. Ranked and Casual matches, lobbies, spectator mode, replays, and more ensure a competitive experience no matter where you are or who you’re fighting.

Gameplay Features

• Master Flow and Energy Points
Control the fight by using Flow to dash, evade, and outmaneuver opponents with high-speed mobility, then build Energy Points through skilled play to unleash enhanced special moves and powerful cinematic Super Arts that can turn the tide of battle.

• Support Characters
Choose from three support characters to accompany your fighter, each providing unique abilities that enhance different strengths and open up new strategic possibilities. Experiment with combinations and discover the partnership that best fits your style.

title: The Legend of Heroes: Trails in the Sky 2nd Chapter Remake (demo version) [NSZ][DEMO][ENG]
description:
Syuzhet prodolzhaetsya srazu posle sobytiy pervoy chasti. Estel i Dzhoshua poluchili zvanie starshikh strannikov, odnako v kanun Prazdnika dnya rozhdeniya korolevy Dzhoshua raskryvaet mrachnuyu pravdu o svoyom proshlom i ischezaet, ostaviv lish kratkoe proshchanie: «Proshchay, Estel…»
Vooruzhyonnaya ego gubnoy garmoshkoy i nepokolebimoy reshimostyu, geroinya otpravlyaetsya na poiski naparnika po vsemu kontinentu. Protivostoyat Estel budet zloveshchee obshchestvo Uroboros, vykhodyashchee iz teni, chtoby pogruzit Liberl v khaos. Stolitsa v ogne, gigantskiy dirizhabl nakryvaet nebo tenyu, i nad korolevstvom navisaet ugroza Siyayushchego koltsa. Estel i eyo soyuznikam predstoit nayti Dzhoshua i rasputat klubok zagovora, spletyonnogo Uroborosom.

title: Sacred 2 Remaster [RePack][NSZ][RUS (Mod.)]
developer: Ascaron, SparklingBit, Jumpgate AB, Funatics, Nukklear
interface_lang: Russian [RUS], port by WallsOfJericho, translation by «Akelly» + fixes BangUber
description:
Ancaria stands on the brink. T-Energy, the mysterious power source that once brought prosperity, now fuels corruption, conflict, and chaos. In the midst of war and betrayal, seven heroes rise — each with their own fate, abilities, and path through a living, breathing open world.

In this remaster of the beloved action RPG Sacred 2: Fallen Angel, players return to a massive fantasy realm filled with hundreds of quests, dangerous dungeons, and unique combat arts to master. Battle monstrous creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your character through loot, leveling, and deep customization.

With refined combat mechanics, a modern UI, full controller support, and all expansions included, the remaster brings new life to a fan-favorite — whether you’re revisiting Ancaria or setting foot in it for the first time.

Forge your legend. The fate of Ancaria awaits.

title: Steins Gate Re Boot (Reboot) [NSP][ENG]
description:
A remake of your favorite visual novel with updated graphics and a new story route!..
The project is a massive reimagining of the iconic time travel story. The original character designer huke completely updated the appearance of the characters and their outfits to modern standards, and thanks to the integration of the E-mote animation engine, the usual 2D sprites received smooth movements and lively facial expressions. The number of background locations has increased by about 20%, and the number of story illustrations has doubled compared to the original. The entire cast re-recorded the characters' lines, and composer Takeshi Abo provided updated arrangements for each musical track.
The plot basis of the remake is based on the STEINS;GATE ELITE script - new dialogues and a full-fledged branch for Moeki Kiryu, created on the basis of Hyde of the Dark Dimension, have been added! Repak with translation here.
Other games in the STEINS;GATE series.

title: Grimoire Groves [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Home to magical creatures and plants, the fabled Grimoire Groves should’ve been a haven for witches looking for a new home. But by the time they arrive, the forest spirits have disappeared and only a few plant creatures remain. But not all is lost. With a little hard work, investigation and magic, the witches might just restore the Grimoire Groves to the lush forest it once was!

Master Witch Magic
Unlock and learn new spells to complete your grimoire. Mix and match different spells to find your own brand of magic and master the balance between all four elements. 

Grow, Forage and Craft
Discover all that the groves have to offer! Collect fruits, craft new spells and items and grow plant creatures to repopulate the forest. Honor the witch tradition of foraging and learn to enhance your powers.

Befriend Mythical Creatures
Find the fabled forest spirits and give them a new home. Help them restore the balance of the groves by boosting their magical powers, as well as your own, with decorations around your cottage. 

Unravel the Mystery of the Rainbow Socks
Embark on a journey to recover the most mythical item to ever exist – the fabled Rainbow Socks – as you investigate what disturbed the careful balance of the magical forest.

title: Fantasista Asuka, Magical Nut Ikuno Crystal Combi Collection [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Goryachiy zhenskiy futbol — eto to, chto vy zhdali!.. Igrayte za trenera zhenskoy futbolnoy komandy, kotoromu porucheno provesti svoikh ekstsentrichnykh milykh igrokov k pobede! Otkryvayte novykh dam i usilivayte svoyu komandu, vyigryvaya napryazhyonnye matchi protiv sopernits!
Kak i v drugikh proektakh studii, v igre prisutstvuet otkrovennyy kontent: osobye priyomy mogut razryvat formu futbolistok, vynuzhdaya ikh ukhodit na pereodevanie. A posle matcha takzhe predusmotrena tseremoniya obmena futbolkami!

title: Toy Tactics [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
description:
Toy Tactics is a physics-based real time tactics game where you can draw unit formations and command units based on minifigs to victory. Under the guidance of legendary generals, master the ability to draw configurations into the battlefield and send miniature legions to war against hordes of undead foes. Charge up your army with artifacts and destructive spells to give you the upper hand in battle and smash your foes in real-time. Create intense battles in both single-player and multiplayer modes in “1v1” or “Co-op”. Think fast, deploy your units strategically, and lead them to victory!

Units inspired on minifigs
All units in Toy Tactics are inspired by miniature figures used to recreate historical battles and fictional ones too! Fight against, or as, skeletal dinosaurs, spooky necromancers, and stealthy samurai. These bloodthirsty enemies want you to utter destruction. Battles occur in many scenarios, from the sunny pirate-dominated island of Tortuga in the Caribbean to the perilous mountains of feudal Japan; expect the unexpected!

Draw unique and personalized formations
Freeze the game at any time to draw new formations. From simple commands to charge and encircle your enemies to more complex strategic formations like pincer or wedge formations, divide your army into battalions and give each one a unique formation. The battlefield is a canvas, and you are its artist.

Real Time Physics for Real Time Strategy!
Just as in a real battle, in Toy Tactics your minifigs helmets are sure to roll. Watch your units fight with fully simulated physics for every encounter, crumble castle walls, and destroy structures. Witness the chaos and destruction unfold in a most epic fashion as the field is flooded with combat scenes.

Unlock Powerful Spells
Turn a bad situation around with our spell and relic system. Defeat enemies to charge up your power, then summon reinforcement catapults, quickly construct medical tents to heal allies or drop flaming meteors onto the heads of your foes. Personalize your strategies by unlocking your favorite spells through our skill tree; the possibilities are endless!

Features:
A physics-based RTS game with a unique drawing system.

- Many unit types with strengths and weaknesses: raptor mounting skeletons, stealthy samurai warriors, impenetrable Roman legions, and many more!
- Magical spells to blow enemies away, heal your allies, bring back fallen enemies as allies, and more!
- Physics simulation system that sends foes flying and helmets rolling.
- Five challenging campaigns, each with its challenging boss fights!
- Five game modes: Campaign, Puzzle, Mercenary, Sandbox and Multiplayer:
-- "Co-op mode": Team up with another player to fight against AI, aiming to survive, coordinate, and produce units. Strategic skills and quick decision-making will be paramount.
-- "1v1": Face off against another player. You will build your army, select powerful relics and spells, and meticulously plan your tactics to emerge victorious.

Toy Tactics offers a hardcore strategy experience that will challenge even the most seasoned commanders! Gear up, draw your formations, and lead your minifig troops to victory. See you on the battlefield, commander!

title: Two Strikes Ultimate edition + 3 DLC [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Experience the electrifying rush of life-or-death duels in a heartbeat!
Dive into Two Strikes, a casual 2D fighting saga adorned with mesmerizing hand-drawn animations, whisking you away to a fierce epoch in Japan, where every stroke of the blade could spell doom or glory.
Position yourself wisely; every move could be your last.
Dart around to close in or evade assaults, seizing the opportunity when foes are within your weapon's grasp!

Striking decisively is your path to triumph, yet tread carefully as predictable moves are easily thwarted.
Outwit adversaries by masking your intentions, feigning attacks with nimble dashes.
And when victory is within sight, unleash devastating strikes to claim your honor!

title: Catto's Post Office [NSZ][ENG]
description: Deliver mail as Catto, the town's dedicated Postcat, while meeting unique friends in a vibrant cozy town filled with kitty residents. As you explore the colorful town, encounter adorable residents and brighten up their day by helping them with silly little tasks.

title: Guts 'n Grunts / Jr. / Sr. [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Inspired by games like Contra and Turrican, Guts 'n Grunts is a mid-paced action game with lots of shooting, swimming, and rolling. Find power-ups. Earn upgrades. Fight for pig freedom!

APR 07, 2060. It has been 40 years since the Technate has taken control of the world. In their arrogance and gluttony, they created a breed of intelligent pig. These pigs were trained from birth to self slaughter when they reach mature age. For a time, the Technocrats enjoyed their meat.

Then, a special boar was born -- one hellbent on destroying the Technate and putting the pigs at their rightful place atop the tower. His name was Rudy Hammon.

Rudy must destroy the Technocratic infrastructure in his mission to dethrone Klaus Küller, the highest of the Technocrats. Along the way, he will face mutants, giant robots, and pork-crazed scientists who can't stop eating.

title: Woodo (demo version) [NSZ][DEMO][RUS/Multi14]
description:
Charuyushchaya, netoroplivaya istoriya, rasskazannaya cherez izgotovlennye vruchnuyu derevyannye dekoratsii. Nikakoy speshki — tolko uyutnyy mir detskikh vospominaniy..
Milaya golovolomka, gde igrokam nuzhno po kusochkam sobirat derevyannye dekoratsii. Kogda vse chasti okazhutsya na svoem meste, dekoratsiya ozhivet i napolnitsya kraskami. V kazhdoy stsene zhdut svoi sobytiya i malenkie syurprizy. Uznay istoriyu Foksi i lyagushki Bena cherez seriyu dekoratsiy, v kazhdoy iz kotorykh zapechatleny chudesnye momenty ikh priklyucheniy.

title: Obakeidoro 2 Chase and Seek [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A chase battle between Monsters and Humans! Round 2!
The new setting is Japan?!

You only have 3 minutes!
Run and hide. If even one person escapes, the Humans win!
If everyone is caught, the Monsters win!
Make use of the Monsters' special abilities to catch the Humans.
Up to 8 players can play together in Local or Online play.

Obakeidoro 2 is an asymmetrical multiplayer action game where players are split into Humans and Monsters to play chase and seek.
Aside from running and hiding, Humans can use their secret weapon, "Activate Lantern," to stun Monsters.
If used skillfully, you may be able to turn a crisis into an opportunity.
The key to winning for Monsters is through their powerful skills. Utilize unique Monster abilities, such as moving through walls or detecting footprints, to catch Humans.

◆ Work together with your friends using the new Human action, "Call"!
This newly added action enables you to call out to nearby allies.
When your allies respond, you can use cooperative actions such as "Solo Throw," "Two Person Jump," or "Bond Forger"!

◆ Round up everyone at once with the new Monster action, "Super Catch"!
Use this new action with improved range and visuals to capture the Humans!

title: Card Quest [NSZ][ENG]
description:
-Deep Tactical Dungeon-Crawling
-A Cozy, Gothic Art Style
-Unique Core Gameplay Per Chapter
-Random Events Triggered While Exploring
-Dream Wheel: Spin for Awesome Chest Loot
-A Spicy Challenge Mode: Strategy Meets Speedrun
-Three Escalating Difficulties: Normal, Hard & Abyss, Each with New Rules

title: Maestro (demo version) [NSP][DEMO][RUS/Multi10]
description:
Ot Lyudviga van Betkhovena s Antonio Luchio Vivaldi do «Zvyozdnykh voyn» s «Garri Potterom»: «Igra prestolov», «Vlastelin kolets», «Ataka titanov», Vilgelm Rikhard Vagner, Iogann Khrizostom Volfgang Amadey Motsart i Dyuk Ellington! Dirizhiruyte polnotsennym simfonicheskim orkestrom v s ispolzovaniem nastoyashchey dirizhyorskoy tekhniki.
Muzykalnaya ritm-igra, v kotoroy vy upravlyaete simfonicheskim orkestrom, ispolzuya tolko svoi dzhoykony. Kazhdoe dvizhenie imeet znachenie: sistema tochno otslezhivaet vashi zhesty, chtoby uderzhivat temp, davat signaly instrumentam i formirovat muzyku v realnom vremeni.
Vyydite na stsenu v polnostyu interaktivnykh kontsertakh s realistichnoy grafikoy, pogruzivshis v epicheskoe vizualnoe i zvukovoe predstavlenie.

title: Sonic Jump (homebrew) [NRO][RUS/Multi9]
description:
Sonic Jump (yap. ソニックジャンプ Sonikku Dzyampu, s angl. — «Sonik: Pryzhok») — videoigra v zhanre platformera iz serii Sonic the Hedgehog, vypushchennaya na mobilnykh telefonakh v 2005 godu i rasprostranyavshayasya cherez servisy Sonic Cafe i Sega Mobile. Pozdnee igra byla perenesena na ustroystva s podderzhkoy operatsionnykh sistem iOS i Android.
Geympley Sonic Jump nasleduet igrovuyu mekhaniku starykh igr serii, vypushchennykh v 1990-e gody, odnako peredvizhenie po urovnyam proiskhodit posredstvom vertikalnogo skrollinga, a igrovoy personazh samostoyatelno prygaet po platformam. Po syuzhetu doktor Eggman pokhitil kamni Izumrudy Khaosa, chtoby zakhvatit s ikh pomoshchyu mir, i postroil sem robotov, kotorye mogut pobedit ezha Sonika. Glavnyy geroy, vmeste so svoimi druzyami, sobiraetsya razrushit kovarnye plany uchyonogo.
Posle vykhoda Sonic Jump byla polozhitelno otsenena pressoy i stala kommercheski uspeshnoy. Zhurnalisty khvalili platformer za grafiku i zvuk.Drugie igry o Sonic'e na Switch.

title: F-Zero X (port NX G-Diffuser) [NRO][ENG]
description:
F-Zero X (yap. エフゼロ Efu dzero X) — avtosimulyator, razrabotannyy i izdannyy Nintendo dlya igrovoy pristavki Nintendo 64 v 1998 godu.
Eto prodolzhenie originalnoy F-Zero (1990) i pervaya igra serii F-Zero s 3D-grafikoy. Igra otlichaetsya krutoy krivoy obucheniya, a igrovoy protsess pokhozh na original. V 2000 godu v Yaponii byl vypushchen F-Zero X Expansion Kit — dopolnenie dlya 64DD, vklyuchayushchee 12 novykh trass, a takzhe redaktory trass i transportnykh sredstv, kotoroe takzhe vklyucheno v razdachu.
V F-Zero X poyavilas vozmozhnost atakovat drugikh gonshchikov, rezhim «Smertelnaya gonka» i generator sluchaynykh trass pod nazvaniem «X Cup». V rezhime «Smertelnaya gonka» tsel igroka — bystro unichtozhit ili obognat 29 drugikh gonshchikov, a v rezhime «X Cup» kazhdyy raz generiruetsya novyy nabor trass. Kritiki khvalili F-Zero X za dinamichnyy igrovoy protsess, obilie trass i transportnykh sredstv, dizayn trass i vysokuyu chastotu kadrov.

title: Phigros (port ) [NRO][ENG]
description:
Dinamichnaya muzykalnaya igra s ritmicheskimi liniyami i chetyrmya tipami not, kotoraya podarit vam osvezhayushchie melodii.
Izuchite bolee 300 vysokokachestvennykh trekov raznykh zhanrov, litsenzirovannykh u izvestnykh muzykantov so vsego mira!..

title: Sacred 2 Fallen Angel Remaster + Ice and Blood [NSZ][ENG]
developer: Ascaron, SparklingBit, Jumpgate AB, Funatics, Nukklear
description:
Ancaria stands on the brink. T-Energy, the mysterious power source that once brought prosperity, now fuels corruption, conflict, and chaos. In the midst of war and betrayal, seven heroes rise — each with their own fate, abilities, and path through a living, breathing open world.

In this remaster of the beloved action RPG Sacred 2: Fallen Angel, players return to a massive fantasy realm filled with hundreds of quests, dangerous dungeons, and unique combat arts to master. Battle monstrous creatures, uncover ancient secrets, and shape your character through loot, leveling, and deep customization.

With refined combat mechanics, a modern UI, full controller support, and all expansions included, the remaster brings new life to a fan-favorite — whether you’re revisiting Ancaria or setting foot in it for the first time.

Forge your legend. The fate of Ancaria awaits.

title: Zombotron Re-Boot (port ) [NRO][RUS/Multi9]
description:
Zombotron Re-Boot — novyy remaster originalnoy serii Flash igr Zombotron, s obnovlennoy grafikoy, uluchshennym fizicheskim dvizhkom i novymi, neveroyatno sochnymi effektami! Srazhaysya s zombi, so zlymi robotami i drugoy nezhityu, chtoby vyzhit v bezumnom mire Zombotron. Deystvie razvorachivaetsya na neizvestnoy, planete, kotoraya so vremenem byla zabroshena i zabyta lyudmi. Naydi i spasi druzey, chtoby vmeste razgadat zagadku tainstvennoy planety.
Dobro pozhalovat na zabroshennuyu planetu Zombotron. Kogda-to eta planeta byla kolonizirovana lyudmi, no spustya nekotoroe vremya lyudi zabrosili i zabyli o ney po neizvestnym prichinam.
Glavnyy geroy Bleyz Rash — frilanser-naemnik. Odnazhdy, dreyfuya v kosmose na svoem kosmicheskom korable v poiskakh novogo zakaza, Bleyz prinyal signal bedstviya s zagadochnoy planety, ne otmechennoy na ego galakticheskikh kartakh, i otpravilsya na pomoshch. No spasatelnaya operatsiya poterpela neudachu. I teper geroyu predstoit ne tolko vyzhit samomu i pomoch bedstvuyushchim, no i razgadat zagadku planety Zombotron. V etom ekshen-platformere vam predstoit srazitsya s beschislennym kolichestvom razlichnykh vragov: zombi, roboty i drugie zagadochnye monstry. Nakhodite oruzhie i uluchshayte navyki, chtoby nayti i spasti vyzhivshikh, i issledovat etu zagadochnuyu planetu vmeste.
— Prorabotannyy razrushaemyy fizicheskiy mir,

title: No Skin [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Face the horrors lurking around the house and discover who the No-Skin Man truly is. 
What started as a normal night with your friends quickly turned into something far more twisted. Fight, talk, trade and pray for one more turn as you delve deeper into each room, trying to survive this madness.

FEATURES:
▪ UNIQUE ART STYLE - hand-drawn pixel art characters and items meet photographic backgrounds, giving the game a distinctive look,
▪ HIGH REPLAYABILITY - choose from different characters, unlock new content between runs and experience unique outcomes with each playthrough,
▪ YOUR PROGRESS MATTERS - collect lunar fragments to buy permanent upgrades that carry over between runs,
HORROR ATMOSPHERE - immerse yourself in the game's unsettling, surreal world, where every corner hides something uncanny,
▪ CAN YOU DISCOVER THE TRUTH? - talk with your friends and piece together fragments of the story hidden within the conversations.

title: Tyrant's Realm [NSP][RUS/Multi11]
description:
Welcome, Brave Hero, to a World Lost in Time.

Embark on a roguelite adventure that pays tribute to the golden era of gaming.
For generations, your family has fought relentlessly to end the reign of the Tyrant, an ancient being who seeks absolute power and knowledge. The journey will push you to your limits, as each run through the ever-changing realms brings new challenges and opportunities.

The world is a brutal, decaying shadow of what it once was, with fallen cities and lost empires turned into treacherous landscapes.

Gear is Your Lifeline. 
As in true roguelite fashion, survival hinges on what you find. Unlock new weapons and armor and find hidden Skull Altars to upgrade your power., and arm yourself for the endless journey ahead. Without these, you are nothing.

Roguelite Progression, Soulslike Combat. 
Each run is unique. Engaging combat mechanic —requiring timing, skill, and a bit of luck—determine your fate. Fight, die, learn, and rise again as the challenge intensifies with every attempt.

Ever-Evolving Worlds and Relentless Foes. 
Every biome and encounter is procedurally generated, with enemies and bosses ready to strike you down at every turn. No two runs are the same.

title: Defender of the Crown the Legend Returns [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
description:
In the 1980s, Defender of the Crown helped define a new kind of cinematic strategy game. Now it returns, rebuilt for modern platforms and remastered with an entirely new way to play.  
 

Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power. It's the Defender of the Crown you remember - just sharper, cleaner, and built for today.   

Three Ways to Play   

Retro Mode. The original Amiga classic, preserved with near-perfect authenticity and quality-of-life enhancements.  

Classic Mode. Amiga classic reimagined for today. A completely new visual identity, refined mechanics, and smoother systems.  

Kingdom Mode. An entirely new challenge. Procedurally generated maps, special dice mechanics, unlockable abilities, and multiple difficulty levels to keep every run unpredictable.   

Faithful to Its Roots, Built for Today  

Everything that made the original special is intact: the ruleset, the pacing, the atmosphere. What's changed is everything around it - cleaner systems, improved balance, a modernized interface, and quality-of-life updates throughout.

title: Grayland Remastered [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A noir story of a tiny bird fighting to bring color back to a dying world.

Caught in the endless war between Humans and Aliens, you are a small bird struggling to survive in the ruined, radioactive lands of Grayland. What was once a peaceful home has become a scorched, lifeless battlefield.

Fly through breathtaking hand-painted environments, dodge enemy drones, cleanse toxic hotspots, and confront colossal bosses on your journey to save your loved ones. Discover the haunting mystery behind the fall of this world—and fight to restore hope where none remains.

Key Features
• 16 handcrafted, challenging levels
• Atmospheric noir visuals and a deeply emotional story
• Varied and intense boss encounters
• A beautiful, immersive soundtrack
• Rebalanced difficulty for smoother, more rewarding progression

Even the smallest being can change the fate of a world.
Be the one who brings life back to Grayland.

title: The Lord of the Rings: War in the North Legacy edition [NSZ][RUS/Multi9]
description:
A Shadow rises in the North. Step into a darker, grittier Middle-earth where war rages beyond the Fellowship’s path. The Lord of the Rings: War in the North™ - Legacy Edition expands Tolkien’s epic legendarium, delving into the brutal, untold story of Agandaûr, a Black Númenórean and servant of Sauron who has rallied an immense force in the ruins of Fornost. While Frodo and Samwise embark on their journey to Mount Doom, a new Fellowship must rise and defend the North. Let this be the hour when we draw swords together!

Choose Your Orc-Bane – Seamlessly hot-swap between three uniquely skilled characters.
Eradan: Dúnedain Ranger–Stealth and precision with bows and swords
Andriel: Elven Loremaster–Magical support with healing and area-of-effect spells
Farin: Dwarven Champion–Tank-like durability and devastating melee attacks

Co-op Fellowship – Play with up to 2 friends online. The survival of your Fellowship and all of Middle-earth depends upon your uniquely skilled heroes working together. Fight together or die alone!

Deep RPG Progression – Customize your hero with unique skills, abilities, and gear. Collect powerful weapons and armor to shape your playstyle.

Command a Great Eagle – Call upon Beleram, a mighty Great Eagle, to strike from the skies and turn the tide of battle.

Iconic Cameos & Locations – Encounter familiar faces like Aragorn, Gandalf, and Elrond as you journey through lore-rich locations including the Elven sanctuaries of Rivendell and Lórien, the daunting heights of The Lonely Mountain, and the fog-laden paths of Mirkwood.

Darker, Grittier Middle-earth – Experience the brutal reality of war with mature storytelling, blood-soaked battlefields, and the desperate fight to defend the North against Sauron’s advancing armies.

A World Full of Peril – The world is gnawed by nameless things. Face ruthless Orcs, monstrous Trolls, deadly Wargs, spectral Barrow-wights, and the dark sorcery of Agandaûr’s forces in epic battles across Middle-earth. Don’t be hasty—Agandaûr commands even greater terrors, summoning Fell Beasts and Creatures of Shadow to his aid.

Forth, and Fear No Darkness! What Say You?!

title: Diddy Kong Racing (port Golden Balloon NX) [NRO][ENG]
description:
Roditeli Tigra Timbera otpravilis v otpusk i ostavili ostrov na popechenie svoego syna, i on i ego druzya organizovali gonku. Ikh vesele prervano pribytiem zlogo mezhgalakticheskogo svintusa-volshebnika po imeni Vizpig, kotoryy reshil zakhvatit ostrov posle zakhvata gonochnykh trass na ego sobstvennoy planete. On prevrashchaet chetyryokh strazhey ostrova — tritseratopsa Triki, osminoga Babblera, morzha Blyui i drakona Smoki — v svoikh pomoshchnikov. Edinstvennym resheniem dlya obitateley ostrova ostaetsya pobeda nad Vizpigom v serii gonok na mashinakh, sudakh na vozdushnoy podushke i samolyotakh. Luchshiy gonshchik ostrova, petukh Dramstik, provalil ispytanie i byl prevrashchyon v lyagushku magiey Vizpiga.
Diddy Kong Racing — gonochnaya videoigra, razrabotannaya i izdannaya kompaniey Rare na igrovoy pristavke Nintendo 64. Igra byla izdana v Yaponii i Evrope 21 noyabrya 1997 goda, i 24 noyabrya — v Severnoy Amerike. Deystvie igry proiskhodit na «Ostrove Timbera» i rasskazyvaet o tom, kak Diddi Kong i ego druzya sorevnuyutsya v gonkakh s antagonistom igry, mezhgalakticheskoy svinyoy-volshebnikom, Vizpigom. Igrok vo vremya igry mozhet vybrat lyubogo iz predstavlennykh personazhey. Diddy Kong Racing vklyuchaet pyat mirov s chetyrmya gonochnymi trassami kazhdaya, i pozvolyaet upravlyat libo mashinoy, libo sudnom na vozdushnoy podushke, libo samolyotom.

title: Tower Dominion [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
description:
Each playthrough begins with a partially generated map that can be further expanded and customized through a modular building system, allowing players to shape the battlefield around their strategy. 

Experiment with different combinations of buildings, weapons, perks, and doctrines to create powerful builds capable of surviving increasingly dangerous enemy waves. Unlock new possibilities over time, push your strategies further in Extended Mode, and take on higher difficulties designed to challenge even experienced players. 

Tower Dominion features:

• Modular map system with partially generated layouts
• 5 difficulty levels, including additional endgame challenges
• Extended Mode for testing builds beyond the standard run length
• 3 playable factions with distinct gameplay styles
• 30 heroes with unique perks and synergies
• 22 enemy types, including powerful late-wave units
• 70+ buildings and 50 weapons for varied defensive setups
• 180+ doctrines allowing flexible and experimental playstyles
• Pits system that adds new modifiers and variety to every run

title: Choppa Rescue Rivals [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Choppa: Rescue Rivals is a modern-but-retro reimagining of the arcade-style action games made famous in the 1980s and 1990s. Like many, we share a deep nostalgia for the vibrant world of the ‘80s and ‘90s media: Arcade games, toys, cartoons and anime that defined our childhoods. Driven by this passion, we set out to create a game that brings those cherished memories to life.

A Nostalgic "Saturday Morning Anime" Storyline
Step into the cockpit with Rick, a legendary rescue chopper pilot coaxed out of retirement for one last, crucial mission on a disaster-ravaged oil rig. With his rescue pilot license freshly reinstated, Rick is thrust into an unexpected scuffle with Burdock, his former wingman turned adversary, uncovering a sinister plot led by the malevolent A.C.R corporation. As the stakes soar higher, Rick and his comrades from the Thunderbolt Rescue Foundation must outwit and outmaneuver their foes to thwart Burdock's dark ambitions.

Dynamic Globetrotting Gameplay
Choppa: Rescue Rivals offers a unique blend of chaotic gameplay, compelling storytelling, and cooperative rivalry. Prepare for an unforgettable ride to the skies where luck, strategy and skill will determine the true heroes. Gather your team and don't forget: It's time to GET TO THE CHOPPA!

Key Features
Embark on an epic single-player story campaign: Navigate through a series of high-stakes rescue missions across the globe with a diverse cast of pilots.

Each pilot brings in their own unique rescue tool and story location, shaping distinct gameplay experiences and demanding new strategies for each rescue mission.

Test your piloting skills: Conquer demanding challenges in each level and hunt down hidden collectibles scattered across each mission for true completionist glory.
 

Customization options: Personalize your gameplay by selecting from a variety of pilots and helicopters, and deck out your chopper with a wide array of stickers.

But wait, there's more! Bring your friends! When you're ready for a break from the campaign, gather up to 4 players for wacky local multiplayer air hockey battles, a high-flying twist on vehicular sports. This time in the sky with choppers!

title: Love Internet and Murder Magic [NSZ][ENG]
description: Love, Internet, and Murder Magic is a Roguelike game. You will role-play an agent of a streamer who died because of a murder. You are trying to "bring her back" through AI technology on the Internet, making her the unique creation of the Internet.

title: Pets Survivors [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
description:
Domesticated animals get wild in roguelike arena shooter combat where survival is all that matters! Pick 1 of 14 playable pets, each with unique skills and stats, as they face hordes of fantasy monsters like slimes, rock giants, oversized bugs, carnivorous plants and more in top-down retro pixel art style.

Choose wisely from a dozen starting weapons, then select a level from areas you’ve unlocked. Take down waves of enemies while strategically keeping your distance from danger. Level up and choose upgrades mid-battle, all in preparation for a big boss showdown. If you succeed, you’ll bank coins you’ve collected to spend on permanent perks, thus stacking the deck in your favor for the next fight!

• Survive waves of incoming enemies in addictive real-time arena combat!
• Choose from more than a dozen domesticated animals.
• Pick a starting weapon and upgrade on-the-fly as you level up!
• Collect coins to spend on permanent stat boosts between stages.
• Use character-specific skills to turn the tide of battle!
• Enjoy retro pixel art aesthetics and multiple difficulty options!

title: The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante [NSZ][RUS/Multi6]
description:
Join the main character, Sir Brante, on a journey through the various stages of life and guide your protagonist as his personality is being forged by the cruel injustices of a society divided by class and ruled by outdated traditions. This is a story of a merciless world that punishes those who violate its laws... and the one man who dares to challenge the old order.

Born a commoner with no rights or title, you were never fated for an easy existence. Changing your destiny and becoming a true heir to the Brante family name will put you at odds with the ancient customs and foundations. Go the distance from birth until true death, writing a history of great upheavals, monumental experiences, and difficult choices.

- A narrative RPG with a vibrant, dark fantasy adventure plot
- Every event has multiple possible outcomes, and only you decide which path Sir Brante should follow
- Make any choice you want but beware the unpredictable consequences wrought on by hasty decisions
- Influence the course of history and participate in events that reshape the world around you
- Savor the dark and gritty atmosphere of the Blessed Arknian Empire, where the laws are harsh, gods know little mercy, and everyone's Lot is predetermined by their estate
- Unravel an engaging storyline and accompany your character the whole way through, from birth until his demise

Key features:

Gripping narrative
The gods once bestowed the truth of the Lots unto the realm of mortals, and the Imperial law now demands that every person's life be determined by their estate. The nobles rule, the clergy offer counsel and punish those led astray from the one true path, while the common folk suffer and toil away for the glory of the Empire. You may accept this fate, but it is also within your power to alter the existing world order forever.

Your choice is not an illusion
All of your character's deeds, acquired skills, and the consequences of his actions add up to form a plot that is unique to the current playthrough. Every decision has a price, and you will be held accountable throughout the entire journey. Protect your family and loved ones, reach out for the reins of the state, or challenge the old order – make your choice and witness the aftermath.

Fight for survival
Train your character, cultivating traits such as determination, sensitivity, or endurance. All of the hero's skills will affect his personality, worldview, and relationships, ultimately unlocking new talents and possible storylines in this dark fantasy world!


A path full of hardships
The first complete walkthrough can take you upwards of 15 hours! Numerous branching paths that affect the unfolding story will make every playthrough a unique experience: become a noble judge, learn the ways of the inquisition, plot a revolution as a member of a secret society, or embrace an entirely different purpose. Destiny itself shall bend to your will!

Strive for survival in the harsh reality of dark fantasy! Walk a path full of danger and adventure, take risks, and find your own way in the universe of The Life and Suffering of Sir Brante!

title: Shard Squad + DLC [NSZ][RUS/Multi10]
description:
Survive an insane army of enemies with a squad of elemental creatures! Recruit new members for your team by defeating the bosses that cross your path, and combine their traits to unlock powerful effects! Unity not only brings strength, it also creates new abilities!

MEET THE SHARDS

Over 20 Shards can join your squad! Experiment and discover which ones will become your favorites!

FORM AN ELEMENTAL SQUAD

Choose Shards of Fire, Electric, Water, Nature, and Crystal! Your squad, your rules! Build the team of your dreams to survive the crisis devastating the world of Mellunia!

COMBINE TRAITS

Each Shard has three distinct traits capable of unlocking powerful abilities and effects! Having more than one creature with the desired trait in your team will increase your squad’s power level!

OVERCOME CHALLENGES

Unique events and powerful bosses will appear to test your squad’s skills! Overcome these challenges to earn special rewards for your survival!

title: Luxor Evolved [NSZ][ENG]
description:
The wildly popular neon-soaked arcade shooter arrives on Nintendo Switch™!

The intense marble-matching shooter has evolved into a fast-paced arcade experience that’s unlike any you’ve seen before. The Shooters are stealthier, the Power-Ups more awesome and the combo Chains faster.

LUXOR Evolved builds on the instantly engaging, supremely compelling gameplay of the globally beloved LUXOR series, delivering 65 unique, action-packed levels that reimagine the acclaimed classic gameplay. Each level captivates with stunning visual effects and interactive soundtracks. This number one arcade shooter game has tons of action to keep the challenges coming, your Shooter firing and the marbles flying.

title: Peppered an Existential Platformer [NSZ][RUS/Multi8]
description:
ABOUT
PEPPERED is an existential platformer where you have ONE SHOT at everything.

Every choice, every boss battle, and every failure impact the branching plotline and determine how the story will go and how it will end. Will you save the world - or fail miserably?

SYNOPSIS
Seeing apathy in the face of doomsday, an office intern decides to save the world by themselves. But the world responds by summoning the police, angry mobs, and the media, branding them as a terrorist.

KEY FEATURES
■ BRANCHING NARRATIVE
Multiple endings. Multiple story routes. Your failures and choices affect the story, which branches out heavily — sometimes taking you to completely unique locations with unique scenes, characters, or gameplay mechanics.

■ PLATFORMING ACTION
Run. Jump. Die. Scream at the screen.

■ ONE-SHOT BOSS FIGHTS
Challenging boss fights! If you lose, the game will not reset or give you a second chance — it will go on, incorporating your loss and changing the story accordingly.

■ CHOICES
Make story choices, ranging from dialogue responses to actions. These will either affect the characters, the scene's outcome, or the ending you get.

■ STEALTH SECTIONS
Get caught, sneak past, or find a secret solution. Every section features a unique character, permanent outcomes, and dumb gags.


■ EXPLORATION
Immerse yourself in a bizarre world full of weirdos and sad people! Talk with colorful NPCs, poke around the environment, or ignore it all.

■ COMPLETELY RANDOM CR*P
Maybe you'll have to use a shopping cart to run away from thugs? Perhaps you'll have to write a presentation or gamble with a street corner lunatic? Who knows? (I do.)

■ AN OFFICE CHAIR
You can spin in it.

title: The Room Three 3, 4 Old Sins (port y) [NRO][RUS/Multi8]
description: The Room Three («Komnata Tri») — eto indi-igra i misticheskaya golovolomka, razrabotannaya nezavisimoy britanskoy studiey Fireproof Studios. Igra byla iznachalno vypushchena v noyabre 2015 goda dlya ustroystv s operatsionnoy sistemoy iOS, a pozzhe dlya mobilnykh ustroystv Android i personalnykh kompyuterov. Sut The Room Three svoditsya k tomu, chto igrok dolzhen izuchat pomeshcheniya starinnogo pomestya, predmety i mebel na nalichie taynikov i skrytykh golovolomok, tak kak eto edinstvennyy sposob vybratsya ot tuda.

title: Montabi [NSZ][ENG]
description:
A Creature-Collector Roguelike Deckbuilding Game.

Assemble your team of Montabi to outsmart the bad guys and save the city!

If you're going to be the big hero and save the city, you've gotta get some Montabi! Each Montabi has a unique set of skills, giving you endless combinations for team synergies. Collect equipment and charms and utilize them to chart the path to victory!  

Train your Montabi to grow stronger, unlocking new moves to enhance your team's strategy. As they level up, your Montabi evolve into more powerful forms, gaining new card abilities and expanding your tactical options. If you work together, there's nothing you and your Montabi can't achieve!

Deploy your best strategies to beat up the bad guys in a unique 3x3 grid-based system. With every Montabi's unique abilities, you'll have endless options to outthink the competition and win the day. Just make sure you rest up at a cafe every now and then to recover those hit points!

Select from diverse trainers, each with a unique playstyle. Do you wanna put your team in the perfect position, get right up in their faces and duke it out, or buff up your Montabi with a hearty meal? When the city's at stake, everyone pitches in! Just make sure to stay safe! Like the king in chess, if your trainer is defeated, the game ends.

Feature List
• Build your Montabi Team - Collect and Fight with over 60 Montabi!
• Evolve and Draft Skills - Each time you Montabi evolves, draft a legendary ability!
• Outsmart your Opponents - Strategize on the 3x3 tactical battlemap!
• Choose your Trainer - The student, fighter or chef will lead your synergistic team!

title: Memory of Memorie a Chill Story [NSZ][ENG]
description:
Through Nintendo Switch™ 2, a girl living in another world keeps you company while you work at your desk.

Memory of Memorie : A Chill Story is a work adventure where the story progresses together with the time you spend working, as you share your desk time with Memorie, an apprentice witch.

In a quiet room filled with gentle Celtic music, whenever you sit down to work, Memorie studies magic by your side.

What used to be solitary work time slowly becomes something warmer: time shared with someone.

■ The more you focus, the more the story unfolds

The game features a Pomodoro-based focus timer. As you accumulate focused work sessions, conversations with Memorie and events in her world gradually unlock.

Everyday chats.
Small changes creeping into the village.
And the secret she keeps hidden.

Beyond your work, a new piece of the story awaits.

■ Your focus changes her world

As the story progresses, Memorie's room gradually begins to change.

Her favorite cup.
The glow of magic.
A space growing warmer and richer.

The more you keep going, the more her world moves forward too.

■ Features

・A cozy fantasy workspace with Celtic music and ambient sounds
・A Pomodoro-technique-based focus timer
・Story and world mysteries unlocked through your focus time
・A room that changes as the story progresses
・A calendar system to track your daily focus
・A companion for studying, working, creative projects, and all kinds of desk work

■ The World
